execution.description: Built the Attacker session driver as AttackerProvider(Phase3Provider) and launched a scripted session.

expected: Subclassing Phase3Provider gives the Attacker the v2 limits, compaction and pods, and the session opens under the Attacker role.
observed: Phase3Provider.start refuses any brief whose role is not the Constructor (phase3_runs_the_constructor_only), so the Attacker session failed to open until start went to the base provider's start after the Attacker-only check.
keep: The Constructor-only guard in phase 3 stays; the Attacker driver passes the Attacker-only guard and then calls GraphiteProvider.start, never Phase3Provider.start.
An Attacker proposes no construction, so the driver skips delivery, the bundle and the stall escalation.
change: A phase-4 session inherits phase 3's limits and pods but drives the Attacker role with its own epoch and tools.
